author: GamingBolt
description:
Halo Campaign Evolved’s Skull system isn’t just a way to increase replayability. It’s a means toward fundamentally reimagining the experience, putting you in the driver’s seat to reshape the campaign to your design. 

And, furthermore, the Skull system underlines the remake’s core philosophy: we said it at the outset, but Halo: Campaign Evolved isn’t a replacement for the original experience, but it is an opportunity for one of the most seminal shooters in history to finally reach its definitive version. 

If the finished product delivers everything Halo Studios has promised, this won’t simply be an act of preserving a bonafide classic. It will be the game Combat Evolved players remember playing back in the early-2000s, even if the hardware of the time never allowed Bungie to create it.
title: Halo Campaign Evolved Could Fix The Original’s Biggest Problems

author: GamingBolt
description:
Of all the images that Bethesda could conjure, being backed against a wall seemed the least likely. You'd think that the studio behind The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim, which has crossed 65 million sales, would come across as more secure. But after years of doubts from its most dedicated fans, the middling post-launch response to Starfield and recent layoffs that saw its most experienced talent leave, the studio seemed to have reached its lowest point.

So what better thing to do than go on the offensive and lay out all its cards, as desperate as it may come across to some? That's exactly what this recent “note” to fans has done, and if you thought the 2018 announcement of The Elder Scrolls 6 was a doozy, you might want to sit down for this.
title: Fallout 5, Remasters, and New Games Show Bethesda Getting Aggressive, But A Tad Desperate

author: GamingBolt
description:
Sony continues to stay quiet on an issue that it should have addressed yesterday, and the clamor is rising. It’s snowballed since we last spoke about it, going from a PR nightmare into what looks like several fires to put out on legal and ethical fronts, as lawmakers, activists, publishers, and competitors have hit the giant hard. 

Of course, we all share many of those arguments, and we think it’s Sony’s turn to tell us its position, whatever it may be. We’re diving into why that’s the case and have some interesting thoughts to share. Join us for nuanced takes on the controversy and how those might indicate a rather strange few years ahead for PlayStation.
title: PlayStation's Silence Is Making Its Digital-Only Backlash Even Worse
